hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -q "git commit"; then changed=$(git -C /home/user/ZooXR diff HEAD~1 HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep "Assets/ZooBuilder/Scripts/.*\.cs" || true); if [ -n "$changed" ]; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"ZooBuilder scripts were modified in this commit.
